Oracle Health’s Core Platform Operations (CPO) team supports the core platforms that help run Millennium, spanning Linux infrastructure, Application Tier, WebSphere, Distributed File Systems, Business Objects, and Citrix. Our mission is to keep these platforms reliable, secure, and ready for the healthcare organizations that depend on them, while making them easier to maintain and improve. Our work connects Linux engineering with the behavior of the services running above it. You might trace a performance issue through a server and its middleware dependencies, improve a health check, or turn a repeated maintenance task into reusable automation. Across the team, we use rolling maintenance and canary environments to introduce changes with care. Current initiatives also include developing maintenance orchestration to reduce manual effort and human error. You’ll collaborate with application, networking, security, and infrastructure partners, learn how the pieces fit together, and help turn difficult operational problems into better engineering. Your Role As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll manage, maintain, and enhance physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments. You’ll bring deep technical judgment to system configuration, performance tuning, security patching, capacity planning, and complex troubleshooting, while helping shape the standards and tools the team uses every day. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You’ll guide engineering decisions, mentor colleagues, and turn operational findings into lasting improvements. You’ll also participate in on-call support and serve as an escalation resource for the services within your scope. Why This Work Is Worth Doing If you enjoy following a problem from an application symptom down to the Linux processes, network connections, or resource constraints behind it, there is plenty to explore here. You’ll have opportunities to build useful tools, influence how infrastructure is operated, and see your improvements make daily work better for other engineers. Bring your curiosity, share what you learn, and help us solve the next problem more effectively than the last. Responsibilities What You Will Do Engineer and operate Linux infrastructure. Configure, update, maintain, and troubleshoot physical and virtual Linux servers across production and nonproduction environments, with a focus on availability, performance, stability, and security. Guide reliable design. Evaluate infrastructure configurations and service dependencies, identify failure points, and recommend practical improvements to reliability, scalability, and maintainability. Understand and improve performance. Analyze CPU, memory, storage, filesystem, process, and network behavior. Forecast resource needs, investigate bottlenecks, and tune systems using measured results. Strengthen monitoring. Improve metrics, logging, health checks, and actionable alerts. Use service trends and service-level objectives to identify degradation and prioritize engineering work. Resolve complex incidents. Apply a methodical approach to diagnosis across operating systems, applications, networking, storage, and related dependencies. Coordinate with partner teams to restore service and communicate findings clearly. Prevent recurring failures. Perform root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Translate findings into corrective actions, better diagnostics, runbooks, and engineering improvements. Maintain secure systems. Apply security patches and updates, remediate vulnerabilities, strengthen configurations and access controls, and maintain compliance with applicable security standards and policies. Make production changes safely. Plan maintenance, assess dependencies and risk, prepare rollback procedures, and validate system and application behavior after changes. Automate repeatable work. Develop, test, document, and maintain Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable automation for configuration, maintenance, monitoring, and recovery. Use version control and peer review to keep changes traceable and maintainable. Support application delivery. Partner with developers, network engineers, security teams, and other IT staff on deployments, environment readiness, connectivity, and server-related requirements. Improve resilience and recovery. Help validate backup, restore, and recovery procedures for assigned systems, and address gaps that could delay service restoration. Build team capability. Maintain architecture diagrams, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and change records. Mentor colleagues, share knowledge, and communicate technical risks and recommendations to stakeholders. Contribute to dependable support coverage. Participate in on-call rotations and planned maintenance, provide escalation support for assigned services, and improve the documentation and tooling that make support more effective. What You Will Bring Extensive hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Linux systems in production, including physical and virtual server environments. Strong knowledge of Linux internals, system services, processes, permissions, filesystems, logs, and resource utilization, with the ability to investigate performance and stability issues. Practical scripting and automation experience with Bash, Python, Ansible, or comparable tools, including testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining reusable solutions. Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ports, certificates, and connectivity troubleshooting across application and infrastructure dependencies. Experience with security patching, vulnerability remediation, secure configuration, access controls, and production change management. Experience monitoring system health, responding to incidents, investigating root causes, and implementing improvements that reduce recurring problems. Demonstrated technical leadership through sound engineering decisions, cross-team collaboration, mentoring, and clear documentation. A curious, methodical approach to problem solving and the ability to explain findings, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps to technical and nontechnical audiences. Experience That Would Help You Get Started Experience supporting Oracle Health, Millennium, Cerner applications, or other healthcare or regulated production environments. Experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure or other cloud platforms, hybrid environments, and infrastructure modernization. Familiarity with middleware and application hosting, including WebSphere or WebLogic, and the Linux infrastructure those services depend on. Experience with configuration management, infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, REST APIs, observability, or resilience and recovery testing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can build a lasting impact on the world. We are looking for a passionate Field Application Engineer (FAE) to drive technical engagements with key customers across EMEA, enabling them to build world‑class solutions on NVIDIA platforms. You will act as the primary technical interface between our customers, NVIDIA sales, and NVIDIA engineering teams, ensuring successful design‑in, deployment, and optimization of our GPU, AI, networking, and embedded products. You combine deep technical expertise with strong customer‑facing skills and enjoy solving complex system‑level problems in real customer environments. What You’ll Be Doing Hardware design-in & bring-up: Support integration of NVIDIA silicon (GPUs, ConnectX NICs, BlueField DPUs, Grace & Vera CPUs) into partner system architectures. Participate in schematic reviews, PCB stack-up reviews, EVT/DVT bring-up. Issue triage & escalation: Track, reproduce, and drive resolution of customer bugs across ticketing systems. Coordinate with internal Application Engineers and Product teams, and communicate workarounds, fixes, and release timelines back to the customer. Firmware & software stack support: Guide customers through NVIDIA platform firmware (NIC FW, GPU FW, BMC/BIOS, FPGA, ERoT), GPU Operator, Network Operator, DOCA/OFED, DCGM, MFT tools, and NVQual qualification workflows. Cross-company coordination: Bridge the customer, NVIDIA engineering (GPU, networking, platform SW), third-party vendors, and internal account/program management teams. Lead NDA processes and NVOnline access for partner engineers. Telco / AI-RAN expertise: Work closely with the Aerial SDK Product SA and HQ Telco strategy to support partner Aerial integration, GPU-accelerated L1/L2 RAN, and platform deployment. OEM portfolio support: Support additional OEM partners on HGX, IGX, and MGX reference designs, answering technical questions on power architecture, thermal management, PCIe topology, partner enablement docs, and design proposal reviews. Customer on-site engagement: Oc casional travels to partner sites What We Need To See 15+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role (FAE, Solutions Architect, Systems Engineer) in the datacenter, HPC, networking, or telecom hardware ecosystem. MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field (or equivalent experience). Strong Linux systems knowledge: comfortable with kernel modules, driver stacks, Kubernetes/OpenShift operators, container runtimes, and firmware update workflows. Networking fundamentals: Ethernet, InfiniBand, SR-IOV, RDMA, NIC configuration. Experience with Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX or BlueField is a strong plus. GPU / accelerated computing awareness: understanding of NVIDIA GPU platforms (HGX, MGX, DGX), CUDA, GPU Operator, DCGM. Deep GPU expertise is a plus but can be developed on the job. Hardware-level comfort: ability to read schematics, understand PCIe topology, engage in thermal/mechanical design reviews, and participate in board-level bring-up and debug. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Experience in the telecom / RAN / 5G ecosystem (O-RAN, Aerial, AI-RAN concepts). Familiarity with Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP Previous experience with partner/customer support Background in BMC/Redfish, IPMI, or platform management firmware. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you consider your future, explore what we provide for you and your family at www.nvidiabenefits.com/ , , JR2020158

review_candidates.description: OPERADOR NOC En Yachay Telecomunicaciones impulsamos la transformación digital en el Perú e Hispanoamérica, conectando personas, empresas y oportunidades a través de soluciones innovadoras. Hoy buscamos sumar a nuestro equipo a un Operador NOC, una posición clave para garantizar la continuidad, seguridad y eficiencia de nuestros servicios. Objetivo del Puesto: Monitorear y gestionar la infraestructura de telecomunicaciones y seguridad tecnológica, asegurando la atención oportuna de incidencias y la continuidad operativa de nuestros clientes internos y corporativos. Principales funciones: Responsable del soporte técnico de clientes corporativos en Nivel 1, mediante las líneas de atención corporativa del call center, correo electrónico, WhatsApp. Monitorear las Líneas Dedicadas, Redes Core, Redes Inalámbricas, Seguridad Gestionada, Telefonía y los Datacenter. Crear y resolver los tickets y averías presentados por los clientes corporativos. Escalar con los operadores Nivel 2 los tickets que no puedan resolverse. Escalar con los portadores externos las averías presentadas y solicitar el informe respectivo. Comunicar al Jefe del NOC los mantenimientos de emergencia notificados por los portadores. Elaborar los informes de averías para OSIPTEL mensuales. Perfil que buscamos: Egresado de las carreras de ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica o afines. Especialización en Redes de Datos y Networking. Conocimientos deseables: ·         Fundamentos de telecomunicaciones. ·         Configuración básica de routers y switches. ·         Manejo de herramientas de monitoreo como Cacti, Nagios, PRTG u otras. ·         Linux básico/intermedio: comandos, navegación y edición de archivos. ·         Manejo de Microsoft Office y Google Drive. ·         Modelo OSI y protocolos de red. ·         Uso e interpretación de herramientas como Ping, Traceroute, Nslookup y tablas de enrutamiento. ·         Conocimientos de ciberseguridad y vectores de ataque en red. ·         Programación básica (deseable). ·        Certificaciones Cisco, Fortinet, Sophos, Palo Alto, ITIL, ISO 27001, Ethical Hacking (deseable).. Beneficios Ingreso a Planilla. Remuneración: S/. 2000.00 a S/. 2500.00 Horarios rotativos (turnos mañana, tarde y noche – 06 días de labores y 01 de descanso) Modalidad 100% presencial EPS al 100% Día libre por cumpleaños Oportunidades de desarrollo. Convenios corporativos        Aviso apto para personas con discapacidad Postula y sé parte del cambio tecnológico con Yachay Telecomunicaciones..
